==''Spawning''==
WIP
==''Behavior''==
Adapted Burrowers are Fast-Burrowing Melee Combatants. They are able to burrow underground to ambush their prey, they are completely invulnerable while underground.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Adapted Burrowers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
